target_scope: Grok text prompting; exact model, tools and API settings are not assumed

rules.rule_text: State the task directly for Grok reasoning models.
rules.condition: always

rules.rule_text: State the constraints directly, including the criteria that make the requested result useful.
rules.condition: always

rules.rule_text: State the requested output format directly.
rules.condition: always

rules.rule_text: Place static system instructions, few-shot examples, and reference documents first to form a stable reusable prefix.
rules.source_section: Use prompt caching to lower cost
rules.condition: When the prompt will be reused in a cached multi-turn/API workflow

rules.rule_text: Use the Responses API for Grok reasoning models; Chat Completions is documented as legacy.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Carry encrypted reasoning and other output items back unchanged, using previous_response_id or a complete manually managed history.
rules.source_section: Send encrypted reasoning back with every turn
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: In agent loops append the entire output array before tool results; do not discard, filter, reorder, or rebuild reasoning items.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Reuse a conversation-specific prompt_cache_key and only append to previous input; inspect cached token usage.
rules.source_section: Use prompt caching to lower cost
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Set supported reasoning effort explicitly per request and compare quality, latency, and cost for the exact model.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Prefer streaming and configure timeout above expected request duration; this guide recommends at least 900 seconds, more for long evaluations.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Set max_output_tokens above the expected visible answer length and flag incomplete responses as truncated.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: The current Grok text guide recommends temperature 0.7 and top_p 0.95; treat these as version-scoped API settings, not instructions inside generated prompts.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Retry 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff and distinguish infrastructure failure from model failure.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Define measurable success criteria and evaluate representative data plus edge cases, adversarial inputs, long contexts, and multi-turn cases.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Choose a reliable code, model, or human grader; calibrate model judges against humans and randomize pairwise answer order.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: Tune each model fairly, repeat evaluations, report spread, apply exclusions equally, flag truncation, and record configuration, usage, and latency.
rules.condition: When configuring or evaluating the actual xAI API

rules.rule_text: For nullable schema fields use a type array or anyOf including null; fields outside required are optional.
rules.condition: When configuring JSON Schema output

rules.rule_text: When the schema is defined separately, the system prompt can focus on the extraction task rather than repeating all output fields.
rules.condition: Only when the target API schema is actually provided

rules.rule_text: Describe what each supplied tool does clearly to help the model decide when to use it.
rules.condition: When defining tools available to the target model

rules.rule_text: Set the scope and depth of multi-agent research explicitly.
rules.condition: Only for supported Grok multi-agent research models

rules.rule_text: Ask for organized, structured research output.
rules.condition: Only for supported Grok multi-agent research models

rules.rule_text: Specify desired evidence types, sources, or perspectives.
rules.condition: Only for supported Grok multi-agent research models

rules.rule_text: Break deep research into follow-up turns instead of packing everything into one prompt.
rules.condition: Only for supported Grok multi-agent research models

rules.rule_text: Provide relevant prior knowledge and constraints for multi-agent research.
rules.condition: Only for supported Grok multi-agent research models
